svg.aria-label: large-scale EP's two configurations: prefill with normal dispatch plus contiguous GEMM plus a large batch, decode with low-latency dispatch plus masked GEMM plus CUDA graphs; TBO interleaves two micro-batches' communication and computation; EPLB balances the load with redundant experts

text.tspan: DeepEP normal dispatch: all-to-all over the token count, dynamic shapes
DeepGEMM contiguous: the layout after a Triton permute
16384 tokens per card; no CUDA graph
submit the GPU work first, then the blocking dispatch
DeepGEMM masked: fixed shapes plus a mask
128 to 256 sequences per card; CUDA graph replay
DeepEPMode.AUTO picks by role (PD disaggregation is the precondition)
the batch cut in two; A computes while B does dispatch / combine
prefill +27 to 35%, decode +25.5%; the peak memory halved
count each expert's tokens → redundant experts (256 → 288) → remap
static once / dynamic rebalancing; prefill 1.49x, decode 2.54x

svg.text: the blog of 2025-05-05: DeepSeek-V3 on 96 H100s, 52.3k in / 22.3k out tokens per second per node, $0.20 per million output, up to 5x pure TP
all three libraries come from DeepSeek's open-source week (DeepEP, DeepGEMM, EPLB) and SGLang did the scheduling: three months from #3602 to the blog
